user.description: Log in with your account for the Techem tenant portal (mieter.techem.de).

data_description.username: The email address you use to log in to mieter.techem.de.

reauth_confirm.title: [%key:common::config_flow::title::reauth%]
reauth_confirm.description: The login for {username} failed. Please enter the password again.

reconfigure.description: Update the login for the Techem tenant portal.

data_description.username: The email address you use to log in to mieter.techem.de.

error.no_rental_agreement: No residential unit is linked to this account.
error.interaction_required: Log in once on mieter.techem.de in a browser to complete a pending step, e.g. accepting new terms.

abort.wrong_account: This login belongs to a different residential unit. Add it as a new integration instead.

interaction_required.title: The login needs a step in the browser
interaction_required.description: Techem accepted the password for {username}, but asks for an additional step during login, for example accepting new terms of use. Log in once on [mieter.techem.de]({portal_url}) and complete it. The integration retries automatically.

init.description: Techem marks some readings as implausible and hides them on the portal, often whole months of the heating season.

data_description.skip_implausible: Treat readings Techem marks as implausible as zero consumption in the statistics and show the newest plausible reading in the sensors, like the portal does.
data_description.billing_start_month: The month your billing period (see your heating cost statement) starts in. The billing period sensors sum up the consumption since then. 1 = January, i.e. the calendar year.
